review: This ID has insanely impressive sinking synergy and can inflict great debuffs alongside it. Being an ID that self-applies tremor to spend it on skills later, it does take a bit for this ID to ramp up, but when it does she can inflict up to 3 fragile next turn and if she has an extra slot, 4 defense level next turn which makes her universally insane to set up nukes with. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
